LAS VEGAS – The Dodgers want Tarik Skubal back.

Offer him a salary next year greater than Kyle Tucker’s last year.

If the uncertainty over potential future economic regulations give the Dodgers reservations about signing Skubal to a long-term contract, present him with a deal that would pay him more money than any player has ever made in a single season.

The Dodgers like to talk about the importance of reading and reacting to various situations, and that’s what their efforts to re-sign two-time Cy Young Award winner call for them to do.

As the baseball industry gathered Monday on the Las Vegas Strip for the general managers meetings this week, teams didn’t know the rules under which they would be playing next season, whether there will be a salary cap or some other form of cost control designed to increase franchise valuations.

The prospect of a salary cap or some other form of cost control in the next collective-bargaining agreement could make the Dodgers reluctant to sign Skubal to the kind of eight- to 10-year contract he figures to command on the open market.

As it is, the Dodgers already have a number of long-term commitments on their books. Yoshinobu Yamamoto is under contract through 2035, Ohtani and Will Smith through 2033, Mookie Betts through 2032, Tucker and Blake Snell through 2029.

But in its most recent CBA proposal, Major League Baseball offered to delay the implementation of a salary cap until 2028 and said in a news release that it “is willing to discuss additional appropriate phase-in timeline & procedures for implementation of the Salary Cap and Floor.”

While the pitch was quickly rejected by the players, it confirmed that even if extreme changes are introduced, teams will likely be granted time to make their rosters salary-cap compliant.

The Dodgers have to take advantage of that grace period.

Signing Skubal to a short-term contract with a high average annual value will only cost them money, and they should have plenty of that, provided they are as unaffected as they claim to be by the reported problems of owner Mark Walter’s insurance companies.

They will have to offer Skubal enough money to forfeit the security of a longer deal.

What about $100 million to pitch for them next year? Perhaps a player option or two after that?

If nine figures for one season of baseball sounds expensive, consider the cost of not retaining Skubal.

The Dodgers were crushed by the eventual World Series champion Milwaukee Brewers in the National League Championship Series, but they were still the second-best team in baseball this year.

They have an older roster, but that doesn’t mean this iteration of their team is finished. They could have another championship run in them.

The Dodgers won 100 games this year – and that was with Ohtani injured for the half of the season.

They destroyed the Atlanta Braves in the NLDS – and that was with Ohtani hitting on one leg.

Manage Ohtani better, re-sign Skubal, inject the right amount of youth into their roster, and who’s to say the Dodgers can’t win the World Series next year?

Acquired by the Dodgers at the trade deadline, Skubal quickly became a central figure in their locker room and was entrusted with being their No. 1 starter in the postseason.

“The way he was able to seamlessly transition, not just in terms of on the field, but in the clubhouse, I can’t say enough good things about the impact he made in such a short period of time,” president of baseball operations Andrew Friedman said.

Offering Skubal a short but lucrative deal doesn’t mean he will accept it, of course.

Skubal’s market is “robust,” according to his agent, Scott Boras.

“Pitchers like him deliver what every owner covets, and that’s championships,” Boras said.

The Dodgers owe it to themselves to at least make an attempt to re-sign Skubal, however.

They have a small opening to retain a player they want without compromising their long-term stability.

They have to make the most of it.
news.content: پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود ببینید. لاس وگاس - داجرز خواهان بازگشت طارق اسکوبال است. به او حقوقی بیشتر از حقوق سال گذشته کایل تاکر پیشنهاد دهید. اگر عدم قطعیت در مورد مقررات اقتصادی احتمالی آینده، داجرز را در مورد امضای قرارداد بلندمدت با اسکوبال مردد می‌کند، قراردادی به او پیشنهاد دهید که به او بیش از هر بازیکنی که تاکنون در یک فصل درآمد داشته است، پول بدهد. داجرز دوست دارد درباره اهمیت مطالعه و واکنش به موقعیت‌های مختلف صحبت کند، و این همان چیزی است که تلاش‌های آنها برای امضای قرارداد مجدد با برنده دو جایزه سای یانگ، آنها را به انجام آن ملزم می‌کند. همزمان با اینکه اعضای صنعت بیسبال روز دوشنبه در لاس وگاس استریپ برای جلسات مدیران کل این هفته گرد هم آمدند، تیم‌ها نمی‌دانستند فصل آینده تحت چه قوانینی بازی خواهند کرد، آیا سقف حقوق وجود خواهد داشت یا نوع دیگری از کنترل هزینه‌ها که برای افزایش ارزش‌گذاری فرانچایز طراحی شده است. احتمال تعیین سقف حقوق یا نوعی دیگر از کنترل هزینه در توافق‌نامه چانه‌زنی جمعی بعدی می‌تواند باعث شود داجرز تمایلی به امضای قرارداد هشت تا ده ساله با اسکوبال نداشته باشد، قراردادی که او در بازار آزاد پیش‌بینی می‌کند. در حال حاضر، داجرز تعدادی تعهد بلندمدت در کارنامه خود دارد. یوشینوبو یاماموتو تا سال ۲۰۳۵، اوتانی و ویل اسمیت تا سال ۲۰۳۳، موکی بتس تا سال ۲۰۳۲ و تاکر و بلیک اسنل تا سال ۲۰۲۹ قرارداد دارند. اما لیگ برتر بیسبال در جدیدترین پیشنهاد CBA خود، پیشنهاد به تعویق انداختن اجرای سقف حقوق تا سال ۲۰۲۸ را داده است.

A California man seen getting busted in a viral “child predator sting” video was trying to meet up with a 15-year-old boy for sex at the Ritz-Carlton in Manhattan — and told cops it was his “kink to be with someone young.”

Cody Plumlee, 34, allegedly sent disturbing messages to his target on gay dating app Grindr as part of a sting from social media self-described “child predator hunters” OBL Nation, according to court documents and law enforcement sources.

“I am very much into younger … any nudes?” Plumlee told the boy he believed to be underage, according to a criminal complaint in Manhattan Criminal Court.

“Definitely want to make out, have my c–k sucked…I would breed you,” the alleged perv added.

Plumlee allegedly invited his target to the Ritz on West 28th Street on Sunday, where he was met instead by a 26-year-old man, law enforcement sources told The Post.

He was then confronted by OBL Nation founder Ramy El-Daly, to whom he admitted that he has an “age-kink fetish,” video of the episode shows.

The alleged sex pest was then arrested by the NYPD and told an officer, “He said he was 15, I ignored it, it’s my kink to be with someone young,” according to the criminal complaint.

Plumlee falsely claimed on his LinkedIn page that he worked for Apple, but in fact had been working for a third-party outside vendor that the tech giant used to book travel arrangements, according to a source familiar with the matter.

The OBL Nation Instagram page had incorrectly claimed that the suspect was Apple’s “head of PR” in a video blasted out to its followers.

Plumlee was released without bail following his arraignment later Sunday on misdemeanor charges of third-degree rape, trying to send indecent material to a minor and attempting to endanger welfare of a child.

A lawyer listed as repping him did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
news.content: پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود ببینید. مردی اهل کالیفرنیا که در یک ویدیوی پربازدید «تجاوز به کودکان» دستگیر شد، سعی داشت با یک پسر ۱۵ ساله برای رابطه جنسی در هتل ریتز-کارلتون در منهتن ملاقات کند - و به پلیس گفت که «علاقه‌ی شدیدی به بودن با یک جوان» دارد. طبق اسناد دادگاه و منابع انتظامی، کودی پلاملی، ۳۴ ساله، ظاهراً پیام‌های نگران‌کننده‌ای را در اپلیکیشن دوست‌یابی همجنسگرایان گریندر برای هدف خود ارسال کرده است، که بخشی از حمله‌ی گروه OBL Nation که خود را «شکارچیان کودک‌آزار» در شبکه‌های اجتماعی می‌نامد، بوده است. طبق شکایت کیفری در دادگاه جنایی منهتن، پلاملی به پسری که معتقد است زیر سن قانونی است، گفته است: «من خیلی به عکس‌های برهنه‌ی افراد جوان علاقه دارم... آیا عکس‌های برهنه وجود دارد؟» این منحرف جنسی ادعا شده اضافه کرد: «قطعاً می‌خواهم با تو رابطه جنسی داشته باشم، سکس گروهی من را بکنی... من تو را باردار می‌کنم.» منابع اجرای قانون به واشنگتن پست گفتند که پلاملی ظاهراً روز یکشنبه هدف خود را به هتل ریتز در خیابان بیست و هشتم غربی دعوت کرده است، جایی که به جای او، یک مرد ۲۶ ساله به استقبالش رفته است. سپس او با رامی ال-دالی، بنیانگذار OBL Nation، روبرو شده است و پلاملی در ویدئویی از این قسمت که نشان می‌دهد، اعتراف کرده است که «فتیش سن و سال» دارد. طبق شکایت کیفری، این مزاحم جنسیِ ادعا شده توسط پلیس نیویورک دستگیر شد و به یک افسر گفت: «او گفت ۱۵ ساله است، من نادیده‌اش گرفتم، این اخلاق من است که با یک جوان باشم.» پلاملی در صفحه لینکدین خود به دروغ ادعا کرد که برای اپل کار می‌کند، اما به گفته یک منبع آگاه، در واقع برای یک فروشنده خارجی شخص ثالث کار می‌کرده که این غول فناوری از آن برای رزرو سفر استفاده می‌کرده است. The heroic Oregon dad who ended a school shooter’s rampage cursed the deranged teen out after he shot him.

Kaylub Giamanco, 36, told CBS Mornings there were a few moments after he’d shot 16-year-old Griffin J. John II in a classroom at Bend’s Silver Rail Elementary School on Oct. 15 that the gunman was still alive and trying to speak.

“I didn’t want to hear what he had to say. He had taken lives,” Giamanco recounted on Tuesday. “I said ‘F–k you’.”

“I don’t know what he was about to say and it didn’t matter,” he added. “It didn’t matter. I just knew he had taken the lives of innocent little babies, you know, 5, 8 and 11.”

John had just murdered three students and a teacher with a shotgun when Giamanco snuck after him into the school with his personal handgun and shot the killer down..

This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.

پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود ببینید. پدر قهرمان اهل اورگان که به آشوب یک تیرانداز مدرسه پایان داد، پس از شلیک به نوجوان دیوانه، او را نفرین کرد. کایلوب جیامانکو، ۳۶ ساله، به CBS Mornings گفت که لحظاتی پس از آنکه در ۱۵ اکتبر به گریفین جی. جان دوم، ۱۶ ساله، در کلاس درس مدرسه ابتدایی سیلور ریل بند شلیک کرد، مرد مسلح هنوز زنده بود و سعی می‌کرد صحبت کند. «نمی‌خواستم بشنوم چه می‌گوید.» جیامنکو روز سه‌شنبه تعریف کرد: «او جان انسان‌ها را گرفته بود. من گفتم «لعنت به تو».»
 او اضافه کرد: «نمی‌دانم چه می‌خواست بگوید و مهم هم نبود. مهم نبود. فقط می‌دانستم که جان نوزادان بی‌گناه ۵، ۸ و ۱۱ ساله را گرفته است.»
 جان تازه سه دانش‌آموز و یک معلم را با تفنگ ساچمه‌ای به قتل رسانده بود که جیامنکو با اسلحه کمری شخصی‌اش یواشکی وارد مدرسه شد و قاتل را به ضرب گلوله از پا درآورد. این یک داستان در حال تکمیل است. لطفا برای به‌روزرسانی‌ها دوباره بررسی کنید.

The US Justice Department sued Lyft, alleging the ride-hailing services provider discriminated against passengers with disabilities, including those who use service animals and mobility devices such ​as stowable wheelchairs.

The lawsuit, seeks $53 million for individuals with disabilities whom Lyft allegedly discriminated ​against, and who have submitted complaints to Lyft or the Department of ⁠Justice, the DOJ said in a statement.

Lyft said it disagreed with the allegations ​made in the Justice Department lawsuit that was filed in the US District Court for ​the Northern District of California.

The lawsuit alleges Lyft violated Title III of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, which prohibits private transportation companies from discriminating based on disability.

The lawsuit seeks a court ​order to force Lyft to stop the alleged discrimination, to modify its policies to ​comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act, and to train its staff and drivers on the law, ‌the ⁠Justice Department said.

The Justice Department alleged that Lyft and its drivers routinely refuse service to individuals with disabilities and refuse to reasonably modify Lyft’s policies and practices to avoid such discrimination.

“We have long-standing policies requiring drivers to accommodate riders who travel with service ​animals or use foldable ​mobility devices, and drivers ⁠who violate these policies face serious consequences, including permanent deactivation,” Lyft said in a statement responding to the lawsuit.

Lyft also said ​it has cooperated with the DOJ during its review.

Last year, the ​US government sued ⁠Uber(UBER.N), opens new tab, accusing the ride-sharing company of violating the same federal law by discriminating against passengers with disabilities.

That lawsuit sought $125 million for individuals subjected to the alleged discrimination and who previously ⁠submitted ​complaints to Uber or the Justice Department.

Uber had said ​it disagreed with all of the allegations, and was committed to expanding access and improving the experience of ​riders with disabilities.
news.content: پوشش بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود ببینید. وزارت دادگستری ایالات متحده از لیفت شکایت کرد و ادعا کرد که این ارائه دهنده خدمات تاکسی اینترنتی، نسبت به مسافران دارای معلولیت، از جمله کسانی که از حیوانات خدماتی و وسایل حرکتی مانند صندلی‌های چرخدار قابل حمل استفاده می‌کنند، تبعیض قائل شده است. وزارت دادگستری آمریکا در بیانیه‌ای اعلام کرد که در این دادخواست، ۵۳ میلیون دلار برای افراد دارای معلولیت که گفته می‌شود لیفت علیه آنها تبعیض قائل شده و شکایاتی را به لیفت یا وزارت دادگستری ارائه کرده‌اند، درخواست شده است. لیفت اعلام کرد که با ادعاهای مطرح شده در دادخواست وزارت دادگستری که در دادگاه منطقه‌ای ایالات متحده برای ناحیه شمالی کالیفرنیا ثبت شده است، مخالف است. این دادخواست ادعا می‌کند که لیفت، عنوان سوم قانون آمریکایی‌های دارای معلولیت مصوب ۱۹۹۰ را که شرکت‌های حمل و نقل خصوصی را از تبعیض بر اساس معلولیت منع می‌کند، نقض کرده است. وزارت دادگستری اعلام کرد که این دادخواست به دنبال حکم دادگاه برای مجبور کردن لیفت به توقف تبعیض ادعایی، اصلاح سیاست‌های خود برای رعایت قانون آمریکایی‌های دارای معلولیت و آموزش کارکنان و رانندگان خود در مورد قانون است. وزارت دادگستری ادعا کرد که لیفت و رانندگان آن مرتباً از ارائه خدمات به افراد دارای معلولیت خودداری می‌کنند و از اصلاح منطقی سیاست‌ها و رویه‌های لیفت برای جلوگیری از چنین تبعیضی خودداری می‌کنند. «ما سیاست‌های دیرینه‌ای داریم که رانندگان را ملزم می‌کند تا مسافرانی را که با حیوانات خدماتی سفر می‌کنند یا از وسایل نقلیه تاشو استفاده می‌کنند، در نظر بگیرند و رانندگانی که این سیاست‌ها را نقض می‌کنند با عواقب جدی از جمله موارد زیر روبرو می‌شوند:

The owner of the California farm linked to the E. coli outbreak that left more than 15 people severely sick, including a 6-year-old boy fighting for his life, said his heart goes out to the suffering families.

Brookshire Farms in San Luis Obispo County reopened on Nov. 6 after a 10-day voluntary shutdown while the Department of Public Health investigated the source of the E. coli outbreak.

​“I am destroyed,” Brookshire Farms co-owner Shawn Callaway told The Tribune Friday as the farm reopened for the public.

“We’ve gone through … about 11 days now of numbness. I can’t explain it… I mean, the worries, the fears, the concerns, the ups and downs. I mean, how do you explain it? I don’t know,” he added.

​Authorities said 5 people had laboratory-confirmed E. coli O157 infections after visiting the farm on Oct. 17 or 18, while 10 additional individuals who visited the farm between Oct. 16 and 26 developed matching symptoms.

​Three children also required pediatric intensive care after developing Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS).

Among the affected children is 6-year-old Camden Foy of Nipomo, who is in critical condition at Stanford’s Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital with STEC and HUS following an Oct. 17 visit to Brookshire Farms.

​His grandmother, Linda Strong-Foy, has been sharing constant updates on his health since his hospitalization nearly three weeks ago.

​Camden was admitted to a Santa Maria hospital and subsequently diagnosed on Oct. 27 with HUS, prompting an emergency ambulance transfer to Stanford.

​The tot’s condition quickly escalated into acute neurological complications, leading to severe confusion, brain scans for potential stroke or seizure activity, intubation, and multiple rounds of blood and platelet transfusions between Oct. 29 and 30.

​“He’s on 5 blood pressure meds. An IV BP drip, 3 orals, and a BP patch,” Strong-Foy said in a Facebook post Monday.

​SLO County’s Department of Public Health collected water, food, and other environmental samples at the farm but did not find E. coli O157 specifically.

​The department said that other types of bacteria, including other strains of E. coli, were found at the farm in some samples, but those results did not identify the source of the E. coli O157 outbreak.

​“Although it’s frustrating to not be able to pinpoint the exact source of the infection through environmental lab testing, this is not unexpected, and bacterial contamination is often temporary and difficult to detect through available sampling methods,” County Health Officer Dr. Christy Mulkerin said in a Nov. 6 statement.

Callaway said cleanliness is not a problem at the farm, with the 17 restrooms cleaned regularly and  pumped twice a week. There are also 17 handwashing stations and eight sanitizing stations.

He added that he doesn’t think the pumpkins were the source of the outbreak because many of the victims had no contact with them.

“(The county) never tested our pumpkins,” Callaway told The Tribune. “They refused to test our pumpkins and said it was not in their investigational area because the pumpkins didn’t have the ability to get tested correctly.”

In the days following the outbreak, the county advised residents to wash their pumpkins and avoid touching ones that had already been carved.

As a result, San Luis Opisbo and Santa Maria canceled their annual pumpkin smash events.

Mulkerin later said the county didn’t intend to imply that the pumpkins were the source of the infection.

“We’re really trying to emphasize to the public, ‘Please don’t be afraid of pumpkins,’” she told The Tribune.

Angelina Jolie was pictured enjoying a rare public outing with her sons Pax and Knox.

Page Six obtained photos of the actress and her sons following a dinner date at Cecconi’s restaurant in West Hollywood Sunday night.

Pax, 22, kept a low-profile in a black sweatshirt and sweatpants along with a baseball cap, while Knox, 18, donned brown trousers and a white T-shirt.

Jolie, 51, looked elegant in a brown trench coat, gray pants with an oversized white handbag and shades.

The outing comes days after Page Six exclusively reported that Knox is expected to legally drop his father Brad Pitt’s last name, following in the footsteps of many of his siblings.

“Knox hasn’t filed anything yet, but it’s only a matter of time before he drops Pitt from his last name,” a source exclusively told us Saturday.

“It’s inevitable. It’s just a question of when, and there’s no timeline for that right now. The whole situation is heartbreaking for Brad.”

If the teen does follow through, he would become the fifth of Pitt, 62, and Jolie’s children to legally remove the surname “Pitt.”

The former couple share six children: Maddox, 25, Pax, Zahara, 21, Shiloh, 20, and twins Knox and Vivienne.

While Knox has yet to take legal action, he already dropped “Pitt” from his last name on his high school diploma.

After graduating from Fusion Academy in Los Angeles in June, a source exclusively told Page Six he used the name “Knox Jolie” on his certificate and celebrated the milestone with his mom and siblings Pax, Zahara and Vivienne.

That same month, an insider told us that the “Maleficent” actress “seems quite pleased with herself about the total success of her long-standing, intense, deliberate effort to alienate her children from their father.”

However, a separate source claimed that the mom of six “participated in years of family therapy with Brad and the children for everyone to try to heal after the events that led her to file for divorce.”

Knox’s twin officially dropped her father’s last name on Nov. 2. She now goes by Vivienne Marcheline Jolie, Page Six exclusively confirmed.

Her older sibling Zahara officially changed her name from Zahara Marley Jolie-Pitt to Zahara Marley Jolie in September and had already stopped publicly using her father’s last name before making the change official.

Their older brother Maddox also legally removed “Pitt” from his name in September, becoming Maddox Chivan Jolie and listed the reason for the requested change as “personal.”

Meanwhile, Shiloh was the first of the former couple’s six children to legally drop their father’s last name after filing a petition on her 18th birthday in May 2024. Her request was granted that August.

Pax has not filed a petition to change his name and is the only one of the siblings who remains close with his father’s side of the family, though he “doesn’t have much of a relationship with Brad.”

The “Girl, Interrupted” actress filed for divorce from the “Fight Club” star in September 2016 after two years of marriage. They were together since 2004.

The exes were declared legally single in 2019 before finally settling their divorce in December 2024 following an eight-year legal battle.

Back in September, Jolie made rare comments about her role as a mom, telling L’Officiel that “one of the most important things” to her is to let her six children be “individuals.”

“As a parent, you try to do many things, but you also try to not get in the way of this human being who has a life separate from yours and so much potential in their own mind,” she shared.

Angelina added, “You want to make sure that you support them.”

برای اطلاعات بیشتر در مورد پوشش خبری ما، به نتایج جستجوی خود مراجعه کنید. عکسی از آنجلینا جولی در حال گذراندن یک گردش عمومی نادر با پسرانش پکس و ناکس منتشر شد. پیج سیکس عکس‌هایی از این بازیگر و پسرانش را پس از یک قرار شام در رستوران سیکونی در غرب هالیوود در یکشنبه شب به دست آورده است. پکس، ۲۲ ساله، با یک سویشرت و شلوار راحتی مشکی و کلاه بیسبال، ظاهری بی‌سروصدا داشت، در حالی که ناکس، ۱۸ ساله، شلوار قهوه‌ای و یک تی‌شرت سفید به تن داشت. جولی، ۵۱ ساله، با یک کت بارانی قهوه‌ای، شلوار خاکستری، کیف دستی سفید بزرگ و عینک آفتابی، شیک به نظر می‌رسید. این حضور چند روز پس از آن صورت گرفت که پیج سیکس به طور اختصاصی گزارش داد که انتظار می‌رود ناکس به دنبال بسیاری از خواهر و برادرهایش، نام خانوادگی پدرش برد پیت را به طور قانونی حذف کند. یک منبع به طور اختصاصی روز شنبه به ما گفت: «ناکس هنوز چیزی را ثبت نکرده است، اما فقط مسئله زمان است تا او پیت را از نام خانوادگی خود حذف کند.» «این اجتناب‌ناپذیر است.» فقط سوال این است که چه زمانی، و در حال حاضر هیچ جدول زمانی برای آن وجود ندارد. کل این وضعیت برای برد بسیار ناراحت کننده است.
 اگر این نوجوان این کار را انجام دهد، پنجمین فرزند از فرزندان پیت ۶۲ ساله و جولی خواهد بود که به طور قانونی نام خانوادگی «پیت» را از خود حذف می‌کند.
 این زوج سابق شش فرزند مشترک دارند: مدوکس ۲۵ ساله، پکس، زهرا ۲۱ ساله، شایلو ۲۰ ساله و دوقلوهای ناکس و ویوین. روز خود را با صفحه شش روزانه شروع کنید. لطفاً یک ایمیل معتبر وارد کنید. با کلیک روی لینک بالا، شما با شرایط استفاده و سیاست حفظ حریم خصوصی موافقت می‌کنید. آیا می‌خواهید اخبار مربوط به سلبریتی‌ها را به محض انتشار دریافت کنید؟ در حالی که ناکس هنوز اقدام قانونی نکرده است، او قبلاً «پیت» را از نام خانوادگی خود حذف کرده است.

It’s been an exciting time for Netflix subscribers as we inch closer to 2027.

Reality fans can’t stop buzzing about the chaotic Love Is Blind: Boston reunion; MGM+’s beloved thriller From recently dropped on the platform (and Season 4 is streaming on MGM+); and the newest Natalee Holloway documentary is now streaming for true crime enthusiasts.

Last but not least, a new season of the British spy series Black Doves just arrived on Netflix.

The second-season of the Keira Knightley-led series finds Helen, who’s still betraying her nation’s secrets to the Black Doves, “walking a more treacherous line than ever.” Also starring Andrew Buchan, Sarah Lancashire, and Ben Whishaw, the new episodes find Helen reunited with her best friend Sam (Whishaw) as they search for answers and fight to protect the people they love.

If you already watched Season 2, you’re probably wondering about what the future holds for this captivating thriller. Has Black Doves been renewed for Season 3? Will there be third season of Black Doves on Netflix? Here’s everything we know.

Just like Season 1, the second season of Black Doves consists of six episodes. You can binge all of Season 2 in a little over five hours.

While there’s no official information, several factors point to a Season 3 renewal. The show’s second season not only earned critical praise — it’s Certified Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes — but it’s also currently in the Netflix Top 10.

The best third season indicator, however, is series creator Joe Barton’s comments during a recent interview with Variety. When Barton was asked about a potential Season 3, he responded, “I’m in a writers’ room for it at the moment, and we’re hoping.”

I don’t think a writers’ room would be open unless there was some serious optimism about a renewal. Nothing is official, but we expect Black Doves to return for Season 3.

You can purchase Netflix for $8.99/month. Ad-free monthly options are also available for $19.99 (Standard plan) or $26.99 (Premium option).

The second season of Black Doves is now streaming on Netflix.

news.content: پوشش‌های بیشتر ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود ببینید. با نزدیک شدن به سال ۲۰۲۷، برای مشترکین نتفلیکس دوران هیجان‌انگیزی بوده است. طرفداران رئالیتی شو نمی‌توانند از سر و صدای «عشق کور است: تجدید دیدار بوستون» دست بردارند؛ سریال هیجان‌انگیز محبوب «از» از شبکه MGM+ اخیراً روی این پلتفرم قرار گرفته است (و فصل ۴ آن در MGM+ پخش می‌شود)؛ و جدیدترین مستند ناتالی هالووی اکنون برای علاقه‌مندان به جرایم واقعی در حال پخش است. در آخر، فصل جدید سریال جاسوسی بریتانیایی «کبوتر سیاه» (Black Doves) به تازگی از نتفلیکس پخش شده است. فصل دوم این سریال با بازی کیرا نایتلی، هلن را نشان می‌دهد که هنوز اسرار ملتش را به «کبوتر سیاه» لو می‌دهد و «در مسیری خائنانه‌تر از همیشه قدم برمی‌دارد». «در قسمت‌های جدید که اندرو بوکان، سارا لنکشایر و بن ویشاو نیز در آن بازی می‌کنند، هلن دوباره با بهترین دوستش سم (ویشاو) متحد می‌شود، در حالی که آنها به دنبال پاسخ‌ها هستند و برای محافظت از عزیزانشان می‌جنگند. اگر فصل دوم را تماشا کرده‌اید، احتمالاً از خود می‌پرسید که آینده این تریلر جذاب چه خواهد بود. آیا سریال Black Doves برای فصل سوم تمدید شده است؟ آیا فصل سوم Black Doves در نتفلیکس وجود خواهد داشت؟ در اینجا تمام چیزهایی که می‌دانیم آمده است. درست مانند فصل اول، فصل دوم سریال Black Doves شامل شش قسمت است. می‌توانید تمام فصل دوم را در کمی بیش از پنج ساعت تماشا کنید. اگرچه هیچ اطلاعات رسمی وجود ندارد، اما عوامل متعددی به تمدید فصل سوم اشاره دارند. فصل دوم این سریال نه تنها مورد تحسین منتقدان قرار گرفت - بلکه در Rotten Tomatoes امتیاز Certified Fresh را دریافت کرد - بلکه در حال حاضر در بین 10 سریال برتر نتفلیکس نیز قرار دارد. بهترین‌ها

در فیلم کازینو رویال (۲۰۰۶)، وقتی متصدی بار از جیمز باند پرسید که ودکا مارتینی‌اش را تکان‌داده می‌خواهد یا هم‌زده، این جاسوس با کلافگی جواب داد: «به نظرت برایم مهم است؟»

جمله‌هایی از این دست که انگار سرسری گفته می‌شدند، راه زیرکانه‌ای بودند برای اینکه به تماشاگران نشان دهند دوره تازه‌ای برای ۰۰۷ آغاز شده است و این مجموعه فیلم که سال ۱۹۶۲ شروع شده بود، با آمدن دنیل کریگ از نو ساخته می‌شود.

جمله‌هایی از این دست که انگار سرسری گفته می‌شدند، راه زیرکانه‌ای بودند برای اینکه به تماشاگران نشان دهند دوره تازه‌ای برای ۰۰۷ آغاز شده است و این مجموعه فیلم که سال ۱۹۶۲ شروع شده بود، با آمدن دنیل کریگ از نو ساخته می‌شود.

تهیه‌کنندگان در چند فیلم بعدی میان ادای احترام به گذشته و فاصله گرفتن از برخی عناصر کلیشه‌ای و سطحی این مجموعه تعادل برقرار کردند و دیگر با سخت‌گیری به همه سنت‌ها و کلیشه‌های باند پایبند نماندند.

مدتی بعد در فیلم اسکای‌فال، کیو با بازی بن ویشا از این مامور سرویس مخفی پرسید: «منتظر خودکار انفجاری بودی؟ ما دیگر چندان سراغ این‌جور چیزها نمی‌رویم.»

حالا دو دهه پس از اولین حضور کریگ، این مجموعه قرار است بار دیگر با بازیگر و تیمی خلاق از نو شروع شود. دوران هیجان‌انگیزی برای طرفداران که منتظرند ببینند دوره بعدی جیمز باند چه شکلی پیدا می‌کند.

مواردی که تا الان می‌دانیم، از این قرارند:

پس از سال‌ها گمانه‌زنی، کار حسابی راه افتاده است و انتظار داریم در ماه نوامبر یا دسامبر بفهمیم بازیگر جدید جیمز باند کیست.

ایمی پاسکال، تهیه‌کننده، در ماه اوت به ددلاین گفت: «به نظرم پایان سال حدس خوبی است. ما واقعا خیلی حساب‌شده و دقیق پیش می‌رویم.»

طبق گزارش‌ها، آخرین تست‌های جلوی دوربین اواخر اکتبر انجام شده است، پس اگر اتفاق غیرمنتظره‌ای نیفتد، تصمیم‌گیری تهیه‌کنندگان و امضای قرارداد بازیگر نباید چندان طول بکشد.

بعد از آن، فقط می‌ماند اینکه این خبر چطور اعلام شود. در گذشته، بازیگران باند در یک مراسم سنتی عکاسی یا کنفرانس خبری معرفی می‌شدند.

اما حالا که این مجموعه متعلق به آمازون ام‌جی‌ام است، برخی انتظار دارند این شرکت خبر را از طریق سرویس استریم خودش، پرایم ویدیو، اعلام کند.

گمان می‌رود چند بازیگر برای بازی در بزرگ‌ترین نقش سینمایی بریتانیا به مرحله آخر تست‌ها رسیده باشند. به نظر می‌رسد سه نامزد اصلی اینها باشند:

بازیگران دیگری که نامشان مطرح است:

ولی یادتان باشد که انتخاب کریگ در سال ۲۰۰۵ غافلگیرکننده بود، پس احتمال انتخاب یک نامزد غیرمنتظره را که نامش هنوز زیاد مطرح نشده است، دست‌کم نگیرید.

انتظار می‌رود تولید این فیلم سال ۲۰۲۷ آغاز شود و سال ۲۰۲۸ اکران شود. هنوز تاریخ دقیقی اعلام نشده است.

برنامه‌های فیلمسازی معمولا بسیار تغییرپذیرند اما روشن است که کار ساخت این فیلم حسابی پیش رفته و کارگردان و نویسنده آن مشخص شده‌اند.

این بیست‌وششمین فیلم مجموعه رسمی باند خواهد بود، ولی نام آن هنوز تایید نشده است.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

کارگردانی این فیلم با دنی ویلنوو است که با فیلم‌هایی چون «زندانیان»، «سیکاریو»، «ورود»، «بلید رانر ۲۰۴۹» و سه‌گانه اخیر «تلماسه» با بازی تیموتی شالامی شناخته می‌شود.

این کارگردان فرانسوی-کانادایی پارسال گفت: «برخی از اولین خاطراتم از سینما رفتن با ۰۰۷ گره خورده است. من با تماشای فیلم‌های جیمز باند در کنار پدرم بزرگ شدم، از همان 'دکتر نو' با بازی شان کانری. من طرفدار دوآتشه باند هستم. برای من، باند قلمرویی مقدس است.»

«قصد دارم به این سنت احترام بگذارم و راه را برای ماموریت‌های تازه بسیاری در آینده باز کنم. این مسئولیتی بسیار سنگین است ولی برایم فوق‌العاده هیجان‌انگیز و افتخاری بزرگ هم هست.»

فیلمنامه باند ۲۶ را استیون نایت می‌نویسد که با سریال‌هایی مثل «پیکی بلایندرز» و «خاندان گینس» و فیلم‌هایی از جمله «سوخته»، «اسپنسر»، «لاک» و «دختری در تار عنکبوت» شناخته می‌شود.

استیون نایت گفته که نوشتن یک فیلم باند همیشه جزو آرزوهایی بوده که می‌خواسته است پیش از مرگ برآورده کند و احساس می‌کند با پیوستن به این مجموعه «وظیفه‌ام را در قبال پادشاه و کشورم انجام می‌دهم».

او به بی‌بی‌سی گفت که قصد دارد «برای شخصیت بنویسد، نه برای بازیگر» و «نکته درباره باند این است که دنیا و مجموعه‌ای مستقل برای خودش است. پس قواعد مشخصی دارد.»

«البته باید آن را جلو برد، ولی جایگاهی را که دارد دوست دارم. دوست دارم که بریتانیایی است. دوست دارم که دی‌سی یا مارول نیست... برای همین در قبال متن احساس مسئولیت می‌کنم.»

فقط شش بازیگر نقش جیمز باند را بازی کرده‌اند.

شاید متوجه شده باشید که برخی از این تاریخ‌ها با هم همپوشانی دارند.

دلیلش این است که پس از آن که لازنبی در فیلم «در خدمت سرویس مخفی علیاحضرت» در سال ۱۹۶۹ جای کانری را گرفت، کانری برای فیلم «الماس‌ها ابدی هستند» در سال ۱۹۷۱ دوباره به نقش اصلی برگشت.

کانری بعدها در فیلم «هرگز نگو هرگز دوباره» در سال ۱۹۸۳ هم بازی کرد؛ فیلمی از باند که استودیوی دیگری آن را ساخته بود و جزو مجموعه رسمی فیلم‌ها نیست.

اگر فیلم‌هایی را که جزو مجموعه رسمی نیستند حساب نکنیم، در مجموع ۲۵ فیلم باند ساخته شده است. این فیلم‌ها به ترتیب عبارت‌اند از:

با تغییر مالکیت و روی کار آمدن تیم تازه، احتمالا فیلم جدید باند شروعی دوباره خواهد بود.

با توجه به پایان فیلم «زمانی برای مردن نیست» در سال ۲۰۲۱، ادامه دادن داستان به ترتیب زمانی دشوار است اما تهیه‌کنندگان هنوز گزینه‌های زیادی پیش رو دارند.

در دورانی که تماشاگران عادت کرده‌اند مجموعه‌های بزرگ سینمایی در دنیایی متفاوت یا خط زمانی متفاوتی از نو شروع شوند، ساختن نسخه دیگری از جیمز باند که در دنیایی متفاوت زندگی می‌کند، کار سختی نیست.

باند ۲۶ حتی ممکن است در دوره‌ای بسیار قدیمی‌تر بگذرد؛ ایده‌ای که پس از آنکه تونی گیلروی فاش کرد او و استیون سودربرگ، کارگردان دیگر، پیش‌تر نسخه‌ای از باند را با فضای دهه ۱۹۶۰ پیشنهاد داده بودند، طرفداران بیشتری پیدا کرد.

جدا از این، رالف فاینس، بازیگر، اخیرا گفت که زمانی برای بازی در نقش باند مذاکره کرده بود و به تهیه‌کنندگان پیشنهاد داده بود نسخه‌ای «سیاه و سفید و کاملا به سبک فیلم نوآر» با فضای دهه ۱۹۵۰ بسازند.

هیچ‌کدام از این ایده‌ها عملی نشد، ولی این پیشنهاد به دل برخی طرفداران باند نشست. آنها می‌گفتند یک فیلم تاریخی کمک می‌کند فیلم به شخصیت و کتاب‌های اصلی ایان فلمینگ وفادارتر بماند.

این که فیلم بعدی دقیقا چه شکلی پیدا می‌کند، بعدا روشن خواهد شد. فعلا طرفداران امیدوارند امسال کریسمس زودتر از راه برسد، چون دنیا منتظر اعلام نام مامور بعدی ۰۰۷ است.

کانری بعدها در فیلم «هرگز نگو هرگز دوباره» در سال ۱۹۸۳ هم بازی کرد؛ فیلمی از باند که استودیوی دیگری آن را ساخته بود و جزو مجموعه رسمی فیلم‌ها نیست.

اگر فیلم‌هایی را که جزو مجموعه رسمی نیستند حساب نکنیم، در مجموع ۲۵ فیلم باند ساخته شده است. این فیلم‌ها به ترتیب عبارت‌اند از:

با تغییر مالکیت و روی کار آمدن تیم تازه، احتمالا فیلم جدید باند شروعی دوباره خواهد بود.

با توجه به پایان فیلم «زمانی برای مردن نیست» در سال ۲۰۲۱، ادامه دادن داستان به ترتیب زمانی دشوار است اما تهیه‌کنندگان هنوز گزینه‌های زیادی پیش رو دارند.

در دورانی که تماشاگران عادت کرده‌اند مجموعه‌های بزرگ سینمایی در دنیایی متفاوت یا خط زمانی متفاوتی از نو شروع شوند، ساختن نسخه دیگری از جیمز باند که در دنیایی متفاوت زندگی می‌کند، کار سختی نیست.

باند ۲۶ حتی ممکن است در دوره‌ای بسیار قدیمی‌تر بگذرد؛ ایده‌ای که پس از آنکه تونی گیلروی فاش کرد او و استیون سودربرگ، کارگردان دیگر، پیش‌تر نسخه‌ای از باند را با فضای دهه ۱۹۶۰ پیشنهاد داده بودند، طرفداران بیشتری پیدا کرد.

جدا از این، رالف فاینس، بازیگر، اخیرا گفت که زمانی برای بازی در نقش باند مذاکره کرده بود و به تهیه‌کنندگان پیشنهاد داده بود نسخه‌ای «سیاه و سفید و کاملا به سبک فیلم نوآر» با فضای دهه ۱۹۵۰ بسازند.

هیچ‌کدام از این ایده‌ها عملی نشد، ولی این پیشنهاد به دل برخی طرفداران باند نشست. آنها می‌گفتند یک فیلم تاریخی کمک می‌کند فیلم به شخصیت و کتاب‌های اصلی ایان فلمینگ وفادارتر بماند.

این که فیلم بعدی دقیقا چه شکلی پیدا می‌کند، بعدا روشن خواهد شد. فعلا طرفداران امیدوارند امسال کریسمس زودتر از راه برسد، چون دنیا منتظر اعلام نام مامور بعدی ۰۰۷ است.

news.originalContent:
The 24-hour protest, called by Spain’s two biggest unions, is due to start on Wednesday.

Spain is bracing for a nationwide general strike over soaring rents and the cost of living, as a deepening housing crisis fuels social unrest weeks before a crucial election.

The 24-hour walkout due to begin at midnight on Wednesday was called by Spain’s two biggest unions – the Comisiones Obreras (CCOO) and Union General de Trabajadores (UGT) – under their slogan: wages, housing, prices. The last time the pair called a general strike was in 2012 when the country was engulfed in an austerity crisis.

The protest will disrupt transport, schools, healthcare and other public services across Spain. Flight cancellations and delays are also expected, while public transport in major cities will operate at reduced capacity.

Schools, hospitals, shops and other services could also face closures or reduced staffing, although minimum services will be maintained in essential sectors.

The action follows the September eviction of an 87-year-old, who has since passed away, from her home in Madrid, after her corporate landlord increased the rent. Images of Maricarmen Abascal being forcibly removed on a stretcher struck a nerve. The moment led to nationwide demonstrations and encampments in a wave of protests that also fuelled a political crisis, prompting the government to call the November 29 snap elections.

Wednesday’s strike could help the government bring the housing crisis back to the centre of the political debate, said Luke Stobart, a political analyst who writes about social movements and politics in Spain.

“(Socialist Prime Minister Pedro) Sanchez has been famous for taking risks in the past, and he’s often been quite successful when he’s taken them. And he knows that if you have a general strike before elections, that will force everyone to talk about housing. And that is happening – it is helping to keep housing at the centre of the debate in the run-up to the elections,” Stobart said.

The country has 750,000 fewer homes than it needs, according to the Bank of Spain, which estimates that the gap could exceed one million by 2028.

Rents have rocketed to an average of 1,176 euros ($1,318) per month, and the average salary of a young person is 1,190 euros ($1,333), according to data collated by the Spanish Youth Council.

Many struggling to make ends meet are forced to live in overcrowded shared flats or stay with their parents.

Spain is not alone, as other European nations witness weekly mass protests over costs and living conditions.

While Sanchez has not explicitly endorsed the strike, he praised collective action as the driving force behind the country’s social gains.

“Your eight-hour working day. Your pension. Your public healthcare. None of this fell from the sky. They were collective achievements. We will not let anyone take them away from us,” the prime minister said in a video message on Monday.

He believes his government has more to offer on social policies than political opponents.

But his Spanish Socialist Workers’ Party (PSOE) has suffered in recent months over its handling of the migration crisis in Ceuta. It is also plagued by a series of corruption scandals involving Sanchez’s inner circle and family members.

Recently, a deadly train crash in early November gave the opposition, the conservative Popular Party (PP) and far-right Vox, an opportunity to shift the national debate towards transport safety and what they described as government incompetence.

The crash, which occurred on the same railway line as another deadly accident less than a year earlier, killed 69 people. Transport Minister Oscar Puente, a senior PSOE figure and close ally of Sanchez, resigned.

The PP is ahead in opinion polls and could form a government with Vox, a prospect that would bring a far-right party into Spain’s national government for the first time since the end of Francisco Franco’s 1939-1975 dictatorship.

Both opposition parties have dismissed the strike as politically motivated, accusing unions of targeting the opposition ahead of the election. They have also criticised its timing, coming a day after the state funeral for the victims of the train accident.

Stobart said the strike has multiple layers, with different left-leaning groups putting forward a different narrative.

Some are critical of the government. These include Basque unions ELA and LAB, Galicia’s CIG, and Spain’s CGT, which have accused the regional and national governments of failing to tackle housing speculation.

“It’s not clear whether the big trade union leaders and the government are going to be able to control the narrative,” Stobart said, warning that the protests could develop into a broader wave of social unrest, as seen in France and Italy, potentially backfiring on the government.
news.content: این اعتراض ۲۴ ساعته که توسط دو اتحادیه بزرگ اسپانیا فراخوانده شده است، قرار است از روز چهارشنبه آغاز شود. اسپانیا خود را برای یک اعتصاب عمومی سراسری در اعتراض به افزایش اجاره بها و هزینه‌های زندگی آماده می‌کند، زیرا بحران فزاینده مسکن، چند هفته قبل از انتخابات مهم، ناآرامی‌های اجتماعی را تشدید می‌کند. این اعتصاب ۲۴ ساعته که قرار است از نیمه‌شب چهارشنبه آغاز شود، توسط دو اتحادیه بزرگ اسپانیا - کمیسیون‌های کارگری (CCOO) و اتحادیه عمومی کارگران (UGT) - با شعار «دستمزد، مسکن، قیمت‌ها» فراخوانده شده است. آخرین باری که این دو اتحادیه خواستار اعتصاب عمومی شدند، در سال ۲۰۱۲ بود، زمانی که کشور درگیر بحران ریاضت اقتصادی بود. این اعتراض، حمل و نقل، مدارس، مراقبت‌های بهداشتی و سایر خدمات عمومی را در سراسر اسپانیا مختل خواهد کرد. همچنین انتظار می‌رود پروازها لغو و تأخیر شوند، در حالی که حمل و نقل عمومی در شهرهای بزرگ با ظرفیت کمتری فعالیت خواهد کرد. مدارس، بیمارستان‌ها، مغازه‌ها و سایر خدمات نیز ممکن است با تعطیلی یا کاهش کارکنان مواجه شوند، اگرچه حداقل خدمات در بخش‌های ضروری حفظ خواهد شد. این اقدام پس از آن صورت می‌گیرد که در ماه سپتامبر، یک زن ۸۷ ساله که از آن زمان فوت کرده است، پس از افزایش اجاره بها توسط صاحبخانه‌اش در مادرید، از خانه‌اش در مادرید اخراج شد. تصاویر انتقال اجباری ماریکارمن آباسکال با برانکارد، بسیار تکان‌دهنده بود. این لحظه منجر به تظاهرات و اردو زدن در سراسر کشور و موجی از اعتراضات شد که به بحران سیاسی نیز دامن زد و دولت را وادار به اعلام انتخابات زودهنگام در 29 نوامبر کرد. اعتصاب روز چهارشنبه می‌تواند به دولت کمک کند تا بحران مسکن را به مرکز توجه بازگرداند.

news.originalContent:
Mathias Licharz calls for the ‘unconditional’ release of ousted politicians, including former leader Aung San Suu Kyi.

Myanmar’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has summoned the head of mission at the German embassy in the country over a Facebook video calling for authorities to “unconditionally release” ousted politicians such as former leader Aung San Suu Kyi.

The ministry said in a statement on Tuesday that Mathias Licharz in the video “appeared to fuel opposition to the host country and its Government, thereby inciting internal unrest”.

Licharz met Deputy Foreign Minister Ko Ko Kyaw, was “warned against the video” and handed an aide-memoire, the ministry said.

“The Deputy Minister strongly warned against recurrence of such act and informed him that any similar conduct would be treated with utmost seriousness and would take appropriate actions,” the ministry said.

Licharz posted the video on Sunday, standing outside the former Yangon residence of Win Myint, the figurehead president of Aung San Suu Kyi‘s government that was removed in a 2021 coup.

The German diplomat said in his message, marking Win Myint’s 75th birthday, that the United Nations still regards him as the “legitimate president” of Myanmar.

In the video, he called for authorities to “unconditionally release all those who are arbitrarily detained, including Win Myint and Daw Aung San Suu Kyi” – using the affectionate term by which Aung San Suu Kyi‘s supporters refer to her.

Germany’s embassy in Myanmar did not immediately comment.

Win Myint was jailed in the February 2021 military coup, ending Myanmar’s decade-long democratic experiment.

Since then, pro-democracy rebels rose up and long-simmering ethnic minority rebellions challenging central rule boiled over.

Authorities said in April he had been pardoned of his post-coup convictions – charges that supporters and analysts say were confected to oust the government.

However, Licharz said in his video message his efforts to meet Win Myint had been unfruitful.

“There is only one conclusion,” he said. “U Wint Myint is not a free man. He’s not allowed to meet with whom he would like to meet, and he’s not allowed to communicate independently,” he added, using a male honorific.

The military leadership behind the coup organised elections, installing a nominally civilian government this year, although analysts regard it as a fig leaf for ongoing military rule.

“Should the Charge d’Affaires choose to recognize U Win Myint as President and wish to discontinue his service in Myanmar, the Ministry would have no objection,” the Foreign Ministry statement said on Tuesday.

Aung San Suu Kyi remains detained but was moved to house arrest in the capital Naypyidaw this year, authorities say, where access to the 81-year-old Nobel Peace Prize laureate remains tightly controlled.
news.content: ماتیاس لیچارز خواستار آزادی «بی‌قید و شرط» سیاستمداران برکنار شده، از جمله آنگ سان سوچی، رهبر سابق، شد. وزارت امور خارجه میانمار، رئیس هیئت نمایندگی سفارت آلمان در این کشور را به دلیل انتشار ویدیویی در فیس‌بوک که از مقامات این کشور خواسته بود سیاستمداران برکنار شده مانند آنگ سان سوچی، رهبر سابق، را «بدون قید و شرط» آزاد کنند، احضار کرد. این وزارتخانه روز سه‌شنبه در بیانیه‌ای اعلام کرد که ماتیاس لیچارز در این ویدئو «به نظر می‌رسد که به مخالفت با کشور میزبان و دولت آن دامن زده و در نتیجه ناآرامی‌های داخلی را تحریک کرده است». این وزارتخانه اعلام کرد که لیچارز با کو کو کیاو، معاون وزیر امور خارجه، دیدار کرده و «نسبت به این ویدئو هشدار داده شده» و یک دفترچه خاطرات دستیارش را تحویل گرفته است. این وزارتخانه اعلام کرد: «معاون وزیر قویاً نسبت به تکرار چنین عملی هشدار داد و به او اطلاع داد که با هرگونه رفتار مشابه با نهایت جدیت برخورد خواهد شد و اقدامات مناسب انجام خواهد شد.» لیچارز این ویدیو را روز یکشنبه در حالی که در مقابل محل اقامت سابق وین مینت، رئیس جمهور دست نشانده دولت آنگ سان سوچی که در کودتای سال ۲۰۲۱ برکنار شد، ایستاده بود، منتشر کرد. این دیپلمات آلمانی در پیام خود به مناسبت هفتاد و پنجمین سالگرد تولد وین مینت گفت که سازمان ملل متحد هنوز او را به عنوان «رئیس جمهور مشروع» میانمار می‌شناسد. او در این ویدئو از مقامات خواست تا «بدون قید و شرط همه کسانی را که خودسرانه بازداشت شده‌اند، از جمله وین مینت و داو آنگ سان سوچی» آزاد کنند - با استفاده از اصطلاح محبت‌آمیزی که هواداران آنگ سان سوچی به او خطاب می‌کنند. سفارت آلمان در میانمار این کار را انجام داد

news.originalContent:
Pope Leo XIV urges Argentines to emulate their saints during his landmark visit, drawing crowds unseen for decades.

Pope Leo XIV has urged Argentinians to follow the “holy example” of the country’s saints and build a more “fraternal and caring nation”, as an estimated 650,000 people packed the central city of Cordoba for Mass.

The 71-year-old pontiff, on a 12‑day Latin America tour less than a month after lung cancer surgery, on Tuesday celebrated the liturgy on the esplanade of a military aircraft factory.

The Vatican said it was attended by 650,000 pilgrims, following Monday’s Mass in Buenos Aires, where about 2.5 million worshippers gathered – the largest of his pontificate so far.

In Cordoba, Leo listed Argentinian saints and blessed figures as examples of a unity “between passion for the Gospel and commitment to building a fraternal and caring nation”, urging citizens to evangelise “at school and in the square, in the family and with friends, in the countryside and in the city, at the dairy farm and in the office”.

Faithful travelled from across the country after nearly 40 years without a papal visit. “It was quite a journey,” said Erika Vinales, who travelled 2,000km (1,242 miles) from Patagonia with fellow teacher Elena Llanquenao.

Throughout his three days in Argentina, Leo has repeatedly challenged President Javier Milei’s right-wing government to make the economy more inclusive, protect trade unions and reverse funding cuts that hurt the poor and people with disabilities.

Bryon Donalds, Florida’s governor-elect, and Lt. Gov.-elect Bryan Avila announced their transition team Monday to prepare for their inauguration and handoff from Gov. Ron DeSantis in early January. However, the team, which includes a George W. Bush alumna, has already drawn scrutiny for being too cozy with big business and private equity.

The four-person team is tasked with staffing and cabinet recommendations, outlining legislative priorities, and preparing policy ideas that align with Donalds’ campaign on affordability and cost of living, lowering home and health insurance premiums, and “common sense ideas that are going to make lives better at the end of the day.” (RELATED: Democrats Come Too Close For Comfort In Florida As GOP Hangs On For Dear Life)

Bryon Donalds, Florida’s governor-elect, and Lt. Gov.-elect Bryan Avila announced their transition team Monday to prepare for their inauguration and handoff from Gov. Ron DeSantis in early January. However, the team, which includes a George W. Bush alumna, has already drawn scrutiny for being too cozy with big business and private equity.

The four-person team is tasked with staffing and cabinet recommendations, outlining legislative priorities, and preparing policy ideas that align with Donalds’ campaign on affordability and cost of living, lowering home and health insurance premiums, and “common sense ideas that are going to make lives better at the end of the day.” (RELATED: Democrats Come Too Close For Comfort In Florida As GOP Hangs On For Dear Life)

(Pool Photo/Newsmakers via Getty Images)

What armed citizens say to responding police after a self-defense shooting can put their freedom at risk, firearms instructors and attorneys told the Daily Caller News Foundation.

The instructors and attorneys said that armed citizens make those errors in the immediate aftermath of an encounter, often turning what would be a justified incident of self-defense into a criminal trial. Some of the most common mistakes involved what they did immediately after the incident.

“Odds are if you’re the good person who’s never been involved in the justice system before, you probably have no idea what you’re doing,” Tom Grieve, a former prosecutor who also is a firearms instructor and appears on panels for the United States Concealed Carry Association (USCCA), told the DCNF. Grieve noted that because the vast majority of self-defense uses do not involve any shots being fired, far too many armed citizens can find themselves in trouble. (RELATED: Homeowner Survives Halloween Scare By Firing On 3 Masked Men Who Allegedly Threatened Him)

“They know how to use the police against you because they’ve been through the system,” Grieve said. “They understand what they should or should not do and I see a lot of people walk themselves into criminal charges because law enforcement misidentifies them as the bad guy because they don’t understand how to play the system.”

He Defended Himself. Then Faced MURDER Charges. Surviving a self-defense encounter doesn’t mean the fight is over. For USCCA Member Jacouri, it was just the beginning of a legal battle that would put his freedom and future on the line. His story is a powerful reminder that being a prepared Protector means thinking beyond the moment of danger and being ready for what comes AFTER. See how his USCCA Membership helped him fight for his freedom👇 https://t.co/osrHdtqLeM

One factor that was mentioned was the armed citizen’s interaction with police in the immediate aftermath of the self-defense incident. While all advised caution in what an armed citizen says to police during that timeframe, not all of them agreed on how much to say.

“I’ve been telling people since the 1970s, you need a brief statement,” Second Amendment Foundation (SAF) President Massad Ayoob told the DCNF. “You need to make it clear from the beginning: This guy attacked you. You need to point out the knife that he dropped. You need to point out, you know, witnesses you saw before they disappear. But you must not try to answer any detailed question.”

Ayoob noted that a number of physiological and psychological effects could make it easy for an armed citizen to get facts wrong and look like a liar in front of police.

Attorneys for Freedom partner & managing criminal defense Attorney Andrew C. Marcantel agreed, saying too much could be a problem for an armed citizen, but he had a different view of what to say in the immediate aftermath.

“By far the number one, I mean, and pretty much any criminal defense attorney will tell you this, who handles these types of cases, is speaking to the police and assuming that the police are on their side and assuming they can talk their way out of the situation and assuming they’re in a good shoot, and assuming they’re in actually a good lawful shoot, those assumptions can cause one to get a case of what I call diarrhea of the mouth,” Marcantel told the DCNF. “When the cops show up on the scene and start just volunteering all kinds of information to the police, much of which turns out to be incriminating.”

“And I can’t tell you how many cases, literally countless cases, where myself and the other attorneys at my law firm are sitting around and staffing and strategizing our cases and we turn to each other and we say, ‘This would be a great case. This would ex be an extremely defensible case if only our client hadn’t said that if only that statement wasn’t made from our own client’s mouth to the police on a recording. This would be a great case’” Marcantel continued. “So, the number one rule that we always recommend is just shut up when the police come around.”

ATTENTION ARIZONA RESIDENTS! Catch Attorney Andy Marcantel on Channel 12 discussing a recent self-defense shooting that occurred on I-10 at 5 PM! https://t.co/dszeRVSksW

At the same time, though, there was an emphasis on being the first to call police, what Grieve called “the race to 911.”

“Arguably the best advice a lot of people touched on, which you brought up, is the fact that look, call 911. Win the race to 911 is what you hear a lot of people talk about,” Grieve said. “Be very brief. Don’t go into granular details. I’ve seen people get criminally charged on that as well where they try to give the exact street that they’re on or the time that this happened and they screw those things up.” (RELATED: Assailant Shot By Would-Be Victim; Cops Cite ‘Stand Your Ground’ Law)

Both Grieve and USCCA Principal Training Advisor Rob Chadwick mentioned that 911 calls are recorded before a dispatcher even picks up the phone.

“A lot of people don’t understand the instant you dial 911, even before the operator picks up, you are being recorded and not just what you say but everything that’s going on in the background, those sounds, those intonations can be taken out of context,” Chadwick said. “If you are calm and collected and very professional and you get on and and you are relating what happened that could be interpreted as, ‘Hey this person has no remorse whatsoever. He was totally, maybe it was premeditated, that type of thing versus just the opposite could be true too. This person is hysterical, clearly, they didn’t know what they were doing, they weren’t in control of their emotions. And so, remember all of this is going to be interpreted by other human beings.”

Chadwick also noted that what people post on social media long before an actual self-defense incident happens can be used against them.

“Words do matter, not only words you speak to the police during an incident, but words you put in print ahead of time,” Chadwick said. “I’ve seen so many people really regret putting things on social media ahead of time, like, you know, the famous better to be judged by 12 than carried by six or, you know, some comment on a post, ‘I wish someone would kick in my door, I’ve got my 357 waiting’ you know, inflammatory bravado that is on display for the public to see that, okay, well, maybe this person was actually looking for a fight.”

Marcantel noted exercising one of the key clauses from the famous Miranda warnings can never hurt.

“Your silence cannot be used against you, either as a reason to arrest you or in a court of law later,” Marcantel said. “They can’t even present it against you or else it would be a mistrial and this is why the police are required to mirandize people.”

She Survived the Threat. But Her Fight Wasn’t Over. A self-defense incident can end in seconds, but the legal battle afterward can last YEARS. Milli S.’s story shows why being a prepared Protector means thinking beyond the moment of danger — and understanding what may come next. 👉 Read Milli’s full USCCA Member Story: https://t.co/U80dcWJcZz . . . #USCCA #USCCAMember

“The Miranda decision from the United States Supreme Court requires every cop in the land to warn you that everything that you’re about to tell me can and will be used against you,” Marcantel continued. “Not for you, not for your benefit, not to help you exonerate yourself, against you. And that language was very purposefully imposed upon them by the United States Supreme Court.”

Marcantel also noted that police officers could make mistakes when taking notes regarding the answers to questions about what happened, could hold anti-Second Amendment beliefs or may be suffering from confirmation bias. Marcantel said it was best to avoid having to use force in self-defense in the first place.

“The best thing that you can possibly do is avoid a situation where possible. I always remind people of the difference between what you’re legally allowed to do and what is the smartest thing for you to do,” Marcantel said. “As a criminal defense attorney who has represented thousands of clients on not only gun cases, but all kinds of different cases in the past, I can tell you that even when you prevail at trial and get all of the charges against you dismissed, you do not feel like a winner at the end because you’ve just gone through maybe years of being cranked through the criminal justice system, shelling out tens of thousands of dollars in attorney’s fees, having a constant stress hanging over your head like a cloud, wondering every day whether you’re going to have to spend a substantial amount of your life in a cage.”

“And at the end of it, yes, all the charges are dismissed, but you do not feel like a winner,” Marcantel concluded.

news.originalContent:
Inflation remained high, despite some easing in fuel prices caused by the US war on Iran.

Consumer prices in the United States increased in October more than expected, even as petrol prices fell to a four-month low after some easing of concerns about the long-term impact of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on global markets.

In its latest report released on Tuesday, the US Department of Labor’s Bureau of Labor Statistics said the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for all items rose by 0.4 percent in October, continuing an inflationary trend since July. The average cost of shelter, as well as food, also rose in October, according to the agency.

The Labor Department’s report was higher than the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland, which had forecast the CPI to increase by 0.2 percent, and economists polled by FactSet, who had predicted an increase of 0.3 percent, despite the lowering pressure on energy prices.

On Monday, US President Donald Trump said that future military action against Tehran was unlikely. “Iran militarily is effectively over,” Trump said. “We’re just keeping it the status quo, and we’re doing that really at the behest of countries that are their neighbours.”

The average price of a gallon of petrol fell below $4 ($1.06 per litre) for the first time since July, according to the American Automobile Association. But the average price, currently $3.98, is still significantly higher than the $3.07 mark it was at a year ago. The average price of a gallon of petrol was $2.98 ($0.78 per litre) on February 28, when the US and Israel first struck Iran.

The economy and cost-of-living concerns were leading concerns for voters in midterm elections that were held on November 3, which saw Republicans lose control of both the US House of Representatives and the Senate. A Reuters/Ipsos poll released on the eve of the elections found that 78 percent of voters said cost-of-living was very important or the most important issue for them when considering how they would vote. Democrats, the poll found, were favoured by 43 percent of voters, compared with 32 percent who preferred Republicans to handle it.

How voters view Trump himself has also turned largely negative since the war and its impact on the economy. Only 32 percent of voters approved of his job performance, according to the Reuters/Ipsos poll, just one point above his record low of 31 percent last month.

Trump’s Republican Party was dealt major losses in the midterm elections, losing typically Republican seats in Congress in states like Texas and Kansas.

Trump himself, as well as key members of his administration like Vice President JD Vance, have acknowledged that the war on Iran played a part in those electoral losses.

news.originalContent:
Iran says it is committed to non-proliferation treaty, but hardliners may be pushing for a change in nuclear policy.

Tehran, Iran – Iran says it has not suspended its commitments under the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), but as mediated talks to end the war with the United States continue, broad international inspections of Iranian sites remain far off.

Following US and Israeli attacks on Iran’s main nuclear facilities in and assassinations of senior leaders, Iranian authorities have increasingly discussed the possibility of abandoning the international treaty and building a nuclear bomb.

US President Donald Trump’s threats to attack the underground Pickaxe Mountain complex near the Natanz nuclear facility and other sensitive sites have only emboldened hardliners in Tehran to demand a shift in the country’s nuclear doctrine – under assassinated Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, nuclear weapons were officially forbidden.

Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei emphasised to reporters during a news conference in Tehran on Monday that the Islamic Republic remains committed to the NPT, despite restricting cooperation with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), the United Nations’ nuclear watchdog.

“Other parties have imposed conditions, namely the attacks by the US and Zionist regime against our nuclear facilities which have caused issues concerning implementation of safeguards commitments,” he said, in reference to Israel.

“As long as this situation continues, we cannot act like normal circumstances in our cooperation with the agency,” Baghaei said about the IAEA, while also renewing Tehran’s criticism of its director, Rafael Grossi.

But the spokesman confirmed that new IAEA inspections were conducted days earlier at the Bushehr nuclear power plant.

The electricity generation plant, built in cooperation with Russia and under development for new phases, is the only facility still accessible to the agency, as it was not directly bombed during the war. US warplanes did, however, attack the perimeter of the plant several times and caused damage, prompting partial evacuation of Russian personnel, who have yet to fully return.

IAEA chief Grossi told the UN Security Council in late October that the body was unable to verify Iran’s nuclear material because Tehran “has not provided the requested information and access”.

Ali Vaez, deputy director of the Middle East and North Africa programme at the International Crisis Group, said Tehran is keeping one foot inside the NPT and the other near the exit.

“Allowing inspections at Bushehr is a low-cost gesture designed to keep diplomacy alive and hardliners at bay, while preserving leverage over the underground nuclear sites that matter most,” he told Al Jazeera.

Those sensitive sites include the Natanz, Fordow and Isfahan facilities, among others.

Seyed Hossein Mousavian, a visiting researcher at Princeton University and a former Iranian nuclear negotiator, said Iran’s position “reflects a distinction between honouring its NPT commitments and permitting inspections of facilities that have been bombed”.

Mousavian said the IAEA had no established inspection protocol for nuclear facilities damaged by military attacks, and pointed out that the Iranians fear that IAEA access to sensitive sites would lead to information being shared with the US and Israel that could then be used in future attacks.

“Tehran views restrictions on broader inspections as a security concern rather than necessarily a rejection of its NPT obligations,” he said.

Iran has had one of the most scrutinised nuclear programmes in history, and its international obligations are governed by several treaties and UN resolutions.

The NPT establishes the fundamental rules against nuclear proliferation, while recognising the right to peaceful nuclear energy. A separate safeguards agreement with the IAEA sets out how the agency monitors Iran’s nuclear activities to make sure it isn’t moving towards weapons development. Subsidiary arrangements, UN Security Council resolutions and nuclear agreements have fulfilled additional requirements.

As a party to the NPT, Iran’s peaceful nuclear-use rights are recognised, and it is allowed to undertake peaceful exchanges and receive assistance with nuclear development.

In exchange, the country commits not to receive, manufacture or otherwise acquire nuclear weapons, and to accept safeguards and information sharing in its territory.

Withdrawal requires a notice after a decision has been made that “extraordinary events” have “jeopardised the supreme interests” of the country.

However, the treaty does not protect from conventional military attack, and this gap between promised peaceful-use benefits and actual vulnerability has been at the centre of the appeal by domestic hardliners to leave the NPT.

But such considerations have not been limited to a handful of hawkish figures.

Iran’s security chief Mohsen Rezaei has publicly deliberated the possibility of abandoning the treaty on multiple occasions. Hossein Mohebbi, spokesman of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), said earlier this week that the organisation “will create the necessary preparations” if the Islamic Republic goes through with the decision to change its nuclear doctrine.

Regional mediators like Qatar and Pakistan continue to relay messages between Iran and the US to prevent another all-out war, although analysts have warned that escalation is likely over the coming months.

Tehran has maintained that it will not allow its highly enriched uranium to be taken out of the country, but remains open to downblending it under international supervision inside Iran. It has also said it will not abandon enrichment altogether, but can accept a limit on enrichment as it did with the 2015 nuclear deal that US President Donald Trump unilaterally abandoned in 2018, during his first term in office.

Arriving at a deal that thoroughly addresses Iran’s nuclear programme would also require a resolution to hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz and beyond, something that is unlikely to materialise in the foreseeable future.

“Tehran might be willing to open the door a crack in exchange for tangible American concessions, but it is unlikely to surrender its most valuable nuclear bargaining chips upfront,” the Crisis Group’s Vaez said.

The expert added that a preliminary deal could potentially unlock limited, phased inspections based on the 2025 Cairo agreement between Iran and the IAEA.

The agreement came several months after the US and Israel bombed Iran’s nuclear facilities during the 12-day war of June 2025. It envisaged restored access for agency inspectors to all Iranian facilities, if case-by-case permission is granted by the country’s Supreme National Security Council.

But it was never enforced, and was followed by tensions that led to the US and Israel attacking Iran again on February 28.

“Restoring meaningful transparency over Iran’s nuclear programme will require a larger bargain on enrichment, stockpiles and sanctions relief,” Vaez said.

But Mousavian said Tehran would want more than just a preliminary agreement like the Cairo deal.

“Such cooperation would require a comprehensive agreement that addresses the overall security and nuclear issues; without it, inspections of the bombed sites are unlikely,” he said.

Ali Vaez, deputy director of the Middle East and North Africa programme at the International Crisis Group, said Tehran is keeping one foot inside the NPT and the other near the exit.

“Allowing inspections at Bushehr is a low-cost gesture designed to keep diplomacy alive and hardliners at bay, while preserving leverage over the underground nuclear sites that matter most,” he told Al Jazeera.

Those sensitive sites include the Natanz, Fordow and Isfahan facilities, among others.

Seyed Hossein Mousavian, a visiting researcher at Princeton University and a former Iranian nuclear negotiator, said Iran’s position “reflects a distinction between honouring its NPT commitments and permitting inspections of facilities that have been bombed”.

Mousavian said the IAEA had no established inspection protocol for nuclear facilities damaged by military attacks, and pointed out that the Iranians fear that IAEA access to sensitive sites would lead to information being shared with the US and Israel that could then be used in future attacks.

“Tehran views restrictions on broader inspections as a security concern rather than necessarily a rejection of its NPT obligations,” he said.

Iran has had one of the most scrutinised nuclear programmes in history, and its international obligations are governed by several treaties and UN resolutions.

The NPT establishes the fundamental rules against nuclear proliferation, while recognising the right to peaceful nuclear energy. A separate safeguards agreement with the IAEA sets out how the agency monitors Iran’s nuclear activities to make sure it isn’t moving towards weapons development. Subsidiary arrangements, UN Security Council resolutions and nuclear agreements have fulfilled additional requirements.

As a party to the NPT, Iran’s peaceful nuclear-use rights are recognised, and it is allowed to undertake peaceful exchanges and receive assistance with nuclear development.

In exchange, the country commits not to receive, manufacture or otherwise acquire nuclear weapons, and to accept safeguards and information sharing in its territory.

Withdrawal requires a notice after a decision has been made that “extraordinary events” have “jeopardised the supreme interests” of the country.

However, the treaty does not protect from conventional military attack, and this gap between promised peaceful-use benefits and actual vulnerability has been at the centre of the appeal by domestic hardliners to leave the NPT.

But such considerations have not been limited to a handful of hawkish figures.

Iran’s security chief Mohsen Rezaei has publicly deliberated the possibility of abandoning the treaty on multiple occasions. Hossein Mohebbi, spokesman of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), said earlier this week that the organisation “will create the necessary preparations” if the Islamic Republic goes through with the decision to change its nuclear doctrine.

Regional mediators like Qatar and Pakistan continue to relay messages between Iran and the US to prevent another all-out war, although analysts have warned that escalation is likely over the coming months.

Tehran has maintained that it will not allow its highly enriched uranium to be taken out of the country, but remains open to downblending it under international supervision inside Iran. It has also said it will not abandon enrichment altogether, but can accept a limit on enrichment as it did with the 2015 nuclear deal that US President Donald Trump unilaterally abandoned in 2018, during his first term in office.

Arriving at a deal that thoroughly addresses Iran’s nuclear programme would also require a resolution to hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz and beyond, something that is unlikely to materialise in the foreseeable future.

“Tehran might be willing to open the door a crack in exchange for tangible American concessions, but it is unlikely to surrender its most valuable nuclear bargaining chips upfront,” the Crisis Group’s Vaez said.

The expert added that a preliminary deal could potentially unlock limited, phased inspections based on the 2025 Cairo agreement between Iran and the IAEA.

The agreement came several months after the US and Israel bombed Iran’s nuclear facilities during the 12-day war of June 2025. It envisaged restored access for agency inspectors to all Iranian facilities, if case-by-case permission is granted by the country’s Supreme National Security Council.

But it was never enforced, and was followed by tensions that led to the US and Israel attacking Iran again on February 28.

“Restoring meaningful transparency over Iran’s nuclear programme will require a larger bargain on enrichment, stockpiles and sanctions relief,” Vaez said.

But Mousavian said Tehran would want more than just a preliminary agreement like the Cairo deal.

“Such cooperation would require a comprehensive agreement that addresses the overall security and nuclear issues; without it, inspections of the bombed sites are unlikely,” he said.

news.originalContent:
The maker of Claude is looking to raise up to $64.4bn in one of the largest IPOs in history next week.

Anthropic is seeking a valuation of $1.4 trillion for its upcoming IPO, with the company looking to raise as much as $64.4bn in what would be one of the largest stock market debuts in history.

The company, which makes the Claude AI chatbot, launched its investor roadshow on Tuesday, with reported plans to go public next week.

According to its filing with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on Tuesday, Anthropic plans to offer 825 million shares priced between $70 and $78, giving it a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion when potential shares are included.

It has also secured $26bn in a separate private placement backed by some of the world’s largest tech companies, including Google, Nvidia, Microsoft and AMD.

The listing is being closely watched as a major test for how much investors are still willing to bet on AI companies, which have driven huge gains in tech stocks and the broader US market.

The $1.4 trillion valuation is lower than earlier estimates, which had suggested Anthropic could be valued between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion, as concerns grow about the company’s enormous infrastructure spending and recent swings in AI stock prices.

Those concerns extend beyond Anthropic, with investors increasingly questioning whether AI companies can make enough money to justify their soaring valuations and sustain the boom.

Despite the uncertainty, Anthropic’s growth has been explosive.

The company reported revenues of $17bn in their third quarter, up from $1.4bn a year earlier, as its net losses narrowed. On Tuesday, Anthropic said it was on pace to generate about $81bn in annual revenue, $10bn higher than its estimate a month earlier.

The company credits its growth to the demand for Claude, including from industries like healthcare, financial services and legal services.

But to keep up with that demand, Anthropic has committed almost $900bn to computing costs with partners including Amazon and Google, a massive financial bet on continued demand for its product.

The IPO also lands in an uncertain political climate, with Democrats having just won control of both chambers of the US Congress in the midterm elections last week. The new Democratic-led House of Representatives and Senate have raised the prospect of more regulation of AI companies and new restrictions on the construction of data centres that power the technology.

AI stocks slid after the midterms, with the Nasdaq falling 5.5 percent on Thursday, its biggest one-day drop in more than a year. The selloff, also driven by declines at Nvidia, whose CEO was targeted by an alleged Chinese spy, wiped out trillions of dollars from the market.

Markets have since recovered some of those losses, though the Nasdaq dipped slightly below 1 percent on Tuesday. Some analysts argued the sell-off was an overreaction and that the election was unlikely to derail the expansion of data centres.

news.originalContent:
Herzog calls for an inquiry into the October 7 attacks during a Knesset session amid political gridlock following elections.

Israeli President Isaac Herzog has urged lawmakers to “leave no stone unturned” and launch an investigation into the October 7 attacks by Hamas in a speech opening the new parliamentary session, after the election left Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc short of a majority.

Herzog called on party leaders to “make concessions” and do “everything possible to avoid a repeat election” at the swearing-in of newly elected members in the 26th Knesset on Tuesday.

The Israeli president tasked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming the country’s next government on Sunday, starting the clock for him to cobble together a coalition within 28 days, with a possible 14-day extension.

While also short of a parliamentary majority, Eisenkot and his allies hope to use their newfound legislative power to move rapidly to establish an independent inquiry into the October 7 attacks.

“I am committed in this complex situation to form a national emergency government as quickly as possible,” Eisenkot said, ahead of the Knesset session.

Netanyahu has previously refused to form a commission to investigate the attacks, arguing that a panel appointed by the Israeli Supreme Court would be biased against the government.

On Iran, Herzog said in his speech that Tehran “does not stop even for a moment in its plots and threats, whether directly or through its partners”, repeating the notion from his speech officially delegating Eisenkot to form the new government.

The president said Israel “must fortify the alliance” with the United States amid increasing disapproval of Israel among the US public due to the genocidal war on Gaza and the US-Israel war on Iran.

“Alongside the stubborn and determined war against those who seek to harm us, we must build a stable political horizon in the region with our neighbours,” he said, adding that Israel must “strengthen and even add to the peace agreements with Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, the United Arab Emirates, and Bahrain”.

The speaker of the Knesset, a member of Netanyahu’s Likud Party, will remain in the caretaker position until a new vote is held.

“Yashar, Eisenkot’s party, has already submitted 61 signatures of new parliamentarians demanding that the vote take place as soon as possible,” said Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh, reporting from the occupied West Bank.

Netanyahu and his bloc continue to protest the result of the October 27 elections, claiming foreign interference after Palestinian-Israeli parties secured a 19-seat bloc.

“Those protests have gone unanswered because the results have been certified and every relevant authority has dismissed the allegations that there were widespread violations,” Odeh said.

Eisenkot has yet to strike deals with parties that could bring him to the 61-seat majority needed to form a government. If neither Eisenkot nor Netanyahu forms a coalition, another round of elections could follow.
